annotations.title: Rank Italian territories by tourism figures

description: Ranks and filters Italian comuni, provinces or regions by the tourism figures of one year, with the same rows, order and values as the advanced search (Esplora) on datituristici.it. Use it for questions with criteria, such as the comuni of a region with the most nights or those above a bed occupancy threshold; do not use it to read one known comune (use leggi_dati_comune instead), to look a place up by name (use cerca_comune instead) or to browse names (use elenca_territori instead). Figures are for `anno`, by default the latest year with data; a figure that is not available is null, an empty list means that no territory meets the criteria, and in 2025 `variazione` is null because the counts started including privately rented holiday flats (`nota` explains it). Read-only, public, no authentication; 30 requests per minute per client, shared across tools.

andamento.description: Optional trend of presenze on the previous year: crescita = variazione at least +3%, calo = at most -3%, stabile = in between. Not applied in 2025, where variazione does not exist (see `nota`).

anno.description: Year of the figures, e.g. 2024; default: the latest year with data. A year outside the years with data returns an error that gives them.

filtri.description: Optional thresholds, up to 5 and one per metric: a row is kept when each metric is within its bounds, and a row without that metric is dropped. Example: [{"metrica": "presenze", "min": 100000}, {"metrica": "tasso_occ", "max": 40}].

max.description: Highest accepted value, inclusive; omit it for no upper bound.

metrica.description: Metric to bound: presenze: Nights spent by guests in accommodation establishments in `anno` (one guest staying three nights counts three).; arrivi: Guest arrivals (check-ins) at accommodation establishments in `anno`.; permanenza: Average length of stay in nights: presenze divided by arrivi.; variazione: Percent change of presenze on the previous year; null in 2025 by construction (see `nota`).; stagionalita: Seasonality index from 0 to 100: how much the nights concentrate in the three busiest months (0 = spread evenly over the year, 100 = all in three months).; tasso_occ: Gross bed occupancy in percent: presenze / (posti_letto * 365) * 100.; posti_letto: Bed places in accommodation establishments.; n_esercizi: Number of accommodation establishments.; quota_extra: Share of nights spent in non-hotel establishments (holiday homes, campsites, rented flats and others), in percent.

min.description: Lowest accepted value, inclusive; omit it for no lower bound.

offset.description: Items to skip, default 0: for the next page pass the previous `offset` plus `limite` while `ha_altri` is true.

ordina_per.description: Metric to sort by (meanings under `filtri`), or nome for alphabetical order; default presenze. Rows without the metric come last.

ordine.description: "desc" (default) puts the highest values first, "asc" the lowest.

provincia.description: Optional: keep only these provinces, up to 5, by Italian name, e.g. ["Firenze", "Bolzano"]; not with "regione" as `livello`.

regione.description: Optional: keep only these regions, up to 5, by Italian name in any case, e.g. ["Toscana", "Umbria"].

name: classifica_territori

anno.description: Year of the figures: the requested one, or the latest with data; null only when no figures are loaded.

fonte.description: Source to cite with the figures: processed by DatiTuristici.it from institutional data (ISTAT).

ha_altri.description: True when more items follow this page: ask again with a larger `offset`.

nota.description: Comparability warning in English for 2025 and later (privately rented holiday flats entered the counts), saying in 2025 which arguments were not applied; null otherwise.

offset.description: Items skipped before this page, as requested.

righe.description: The page of ranked rows; an empty list when no territory meets the criteria or past the last page.

arrivi.description: Guest arrivals (check-ins) at accommodation establishments in `anno`. Null if not available.

chiave.description: 6-digit ISTAT code for a comune (the `cod_istat` input of leggi_dati_comune), the name for a province or region.

ha_dati.description: False when ISTAT published no movement figures for this territory in `anno`: its metrics are then null.

n_esercizi.description: Number of accommodation establishments. Null if not available.

nome.description: Name as recorded by ISTAT. Among comuni, a row whose name starts with 'Altri comuni' is not a comune: it is the ISTAT total of the small comuni of its province, published as one row.

permanenza.description: Average length of stay in nights: presenze divided by arrivi. Null if not available.

posti_letto.description: Bed places in accommodation establishments. Null if not available.

presenze.description: Nights spent by guests in accommodation establishments in `anno` (one guest staying three nights counts three). Null if not available.

provincia.description: Province of the row (for a province, itself); null for regions.

quota_extra.description: Share of nights spent in non-hotel establishments (holiday homes, campsites, rented flats and others), in percent. Null if not available.

regione.description: Region of the row (for a region, itself); null if not recorded.

stagionalita.description: Seasonality index from 0 to 100: how much the nights concentrate in the three busiest months (0 = spread evenly over the year, 100 = all in three months). Null if not available.

tasso_occ.description: Gross bed occupancy in percent: presenze / (posti_letto * 365) * 100. Null if not available.

variazione.description: Percent change of presenze on the previous year; null in 2025 by construction (see `nota`). Null if not available.

totale.description: Number of matching items across all pages.

title: Rank Italian territories by tourism figures
